parameters.name: AbroadRegion
parameters.description: The region outside China to query. Supports fuzzy query by region ID or region name in Chinese or English.

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: The country outside China to query. Supports fuzzy query by country ID or country name in Chinese or English.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the current WAF instance ID.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description:
The language used for country and region names in the response. Valid values:

- **en** (**default**): English.

- **cn**: Simplified Chinese.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next page. Set this parameter to the value of the **NextToken** parameter returned from the previous API call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first page query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: The Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
